mn99:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn99:2.1: tena kho pana samayena subho māṇavo todeyyaputto sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati aññatarassa gahapatissa nivesane kenacideva karaṇīyena.
mn99:2.2: atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto yassa gahapatissa nivesane paṭivasati, taṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn99:2.5: kannu khvajja samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyyāmā’ti?
mn99:2.6: ayaṃ bhante, bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn99:3.1: atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto tassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn99:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn99:4.2: gahaṭṭho ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ, na pabbajito ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusala’nti.
mn99:4.6: gihissa vāhaṃ māṇava, pabbajitassa vā micchāpaṭipattiṃ na vaṇṇemi.
mn99:4.7: gihī vā hi māṇava, pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipannādhikaraṇahetu na ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn99:4.8: gihissa vāhaṃ māṇava, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi.
mn99:4.9: gihī vā hi māṇava, pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipannādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusala’nti.
mn99:5.2: ‘mahaṭṭhamidaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ gharāvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:5.3: appaṭṭhamidaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī’ti.
mn99:5.7: atthi māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:5.8: atthi māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:5.9: atthi māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:5.10: atthi māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:6.1: katamañca māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti:
mn99:6.2: kasi kho māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:6.3: katamañca māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti:
mn99:6.4: kasiyeva kho māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:6.5: katamañca māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti:
mn99:6.6: vaṇijjā kho māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:6.7: katamañca māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti:
mn99:6.8: vaṇijjāyeva kho māṇava, kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, kasi kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.2: evameva kho māṇava, gharāvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.3: seyyathāpi māṇava, kasiyeva kammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.4: evameva kho māṇava, gharāvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahaṭṭhaṃ mahākiccaṃ mahādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.5: seyyathāpi māṇava, vaṇijjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.6: evameva kho māṇava, pabbajjākammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ vipajjamānaṃ appaphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.7: seyyathāpi māṇava, vaṇijjāyeva kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
mn99:7.8: evameva kho māṇava, pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaṭṭhaṃ appakiccaṃ appādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ sampajjamānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hotī’ti.
mn99:8.1: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāyāti.
mn99:8.2: ye te māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:8.4: sādhu te pañca dhamme imasmiṃ parisatiṃ bhāsassūti.
mn99:8.5: na kho me bho gotama, garu yatthassu bhavanto vā nisinnā bhavantarūpā vāti.
mn99:9.1: saccaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya, kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:9.2: tapaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā dutiyaṃ dhammaṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:9.3: brahmacariyaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā tatiyaṃ dhammaṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:9.4: ajjhesanaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā catutthaṃ dhammaṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:9.5: cāgaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā pañcamaṃ dhammaṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:9.6: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, ime pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāyāti.
mn99:9.8: kiṃ pana māṇava, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha:
mn99:9.9: ‘ahaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemī’ti?
mn99:9.11: kiṃ pana māṇava, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi ekācariyapācariyopi yāvasattamā ācariyamahayugā, yo evamāha:
mn99:9.12: ahaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemī’ti.
mn99:9.14: kiṃ pana māṇava, yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti, tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, vācitamanuvācenti, seyyathidaṃ: aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu.
mn99:9.16: mayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemā’ti?
mn99:9.18: iti kira māṇava, natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha:
mn99:9.19: ahaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemīti.
mn99:9.20: natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi ekācariyapācariyopi yāvasattamā ācariyamahayugā, yo evamāha:
mn99:9.21: ‘ahaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemī’ti.
mn99:9.22: yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti, tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, vācitamanuvācenti, seyyathidaṃ: aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu.
mn99:9.24: mayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā vipākaṃ pavedemā’ti.
mn99:9.25: no hetaṃ bho gotama. seyyathāpi māṇava, andhaveṇiparamparā saṃsattā:? purimopi na passati, majjhimopi na passati, pacchimopi na passati.
mn99:9.26: evameva kho māṇava, andhaveṇūpamaṃ maññe brāhmaṇānaṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjati. purimopi na passati, majjhimopi na passati, pacchimopi na passatīti.
mn99:10.1: evaṃ vutte subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavatā andhaveṇūpamena vuccamāno kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃyeva khuṃsento bhagavantaṃyeva vambhento bhagavantaṃyeva vadamāno
mn99:10.3: brāhmaṇo bho gotama, pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko evamāha:
mn99:10.4: evameva panimeke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn99:10.5: tesamidaṃ bhāsitaṃ hassakaṃyeva sampajjati, nāmakaṃyeva sampajjati, rittakaṃyeva sampajjati, tucchakaṃyeva sampajjati.
mn99:10.6: kathaṃ hi nāma manussabhūto uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ ñassati vā dakkhiti vā sacchi vā karissati.
mn99:11.1: kiṃ pana māṇava, brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko sabbesaṃyeva samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānātī’ti?
mn99:11.2: sakāyapi hi bho gotama, puṇṇakāya dāsiyā brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko na cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti, kuto pana sabbesaṃyeva samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānissatī’ti?
mn99:12.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, jaccandho puriso na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn99:12.3: natthi kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, natthi kaṇhasukkānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.4: natthi nīlakāni rūpāni, natthi nīlakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.5: natthi pītakāni rūpāni, natthi pītakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.6: natthi lohitakāni rūpāni, natthi lohitakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.7: natthi mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni, natthi mañjeṭṭhikānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.8: natthi sama visamaṃ, natthi samavisamassa dassāvī,
mn99:12.11: ahametaṃ na jānāmi, ahametaṃ na passāmi,
mn99:12.13: sammā nu kho so māṇava, vadamāno vadeyyāti?
mn99:12.15: atthi kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, atthi kaṇhasukkānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.16: atthi nīlakāni rūpāni, atthi nīlakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.17: atthi pītakāni rūpāni, atthi pītakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.18: atthi lohitakāni rūpāni, atthi lohitakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
mn99:12.19: atthi mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni, atthi mañjeṭṭhikānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī,
mn99:12.23: ahametaṃ na jānāmi, ahametaṃ na passāmi
mn99:12.25: na hi so bho gotama, sammā vadamāno vadeyyāti.
mn99:13.1: evameva kho māṇava, brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko andho acakkhuko.
mn99:13.2: so vata uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ ñassati vā dakkhiti vā sacchi vā karissatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn99:13.5: ‘caṅkī brāhmaṇo tārukkho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti brāhmaṇo jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo pitā vā te todeyyo. katamā nesaṃ seyyā’yaṃ vā te sammuccā vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ. yaṃ vā asammuccāti.
mn99:13.7: katamā nesaṃ seyyo, yaṃ vā te mantā vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ. yaṃ vā amantāti?
mn99:13.9: katamā tesaṃ seyyo, yaṃ vā te paṭisaṅkhāya vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ yaṃ vā appaṭisaṅkhāyāti?
mn99:13.11: katamā tesaṃ seyyo, yaṃ vā te atthasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ. yaṃ vā anatthasaṃhitanti?
mn99:14.2: yadi evaṃ sante brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā opamaññena subhagavanikena sammuccā vācā bhāsitā, asammuccā vāti?
mn99:15.5: imehi kho māṇavā pañcahi nīvaraṇehi brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko āvuto nivuto ovuto pariyonaddho.
mn99:15.6: so vata uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchi vā karissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn99:16.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn99:16.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn99:16.9: imehi kho māṇava, pañcahi kāmaguṇehi brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko gathito mucchito ajjhopanno anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
mn99:16.10: so vata uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ ñassati vā dakkhiti vā sacchi vā karissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn99:17.2: yaṃ vā tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca aggiṃ jāleyya, yaṃ vā nissaṭṭhatiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ aggiṃ jāleyya, katamo nu khvāssa aggi accimā ca vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro cāti?
mn99:17.3: sace taṃ bho gotama, ṭhānaṃ nissaṭṭhatiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ aggiṃ jāletuṃ, svāssa aggi accimā ca vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro cāti.
mn99:17.4: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ māṇava, anavakāso, yaṃ nissaṭṭhatiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ aggiṃ jāleyya aññatra iddhimatā.
mn99:17.5: seyyathāpi māṇava, tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati, tathūpamāhaṃ māṇava, imaṃ pītiṃ vadāmi. yāyaṃ pīti pañcakāmaguṇe paṭicca.
mn99:17.6: seyyathāpi māṇava, nissaṭṭhatiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati. tathūpamāhaṃ māṇava, imaṃ pītiṃ vadāmi, yāyaṃ pīti aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi.
mn99:17.7: katamā ca māṇava, pīti aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi:
mn99:17.8: idha māṇava, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn99:17.9: ayampi kho māṇava, pīti aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi.
mn99:17.10: puna caparaṃ māṇava, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn99:17.11: ayampi kho māṇava, pīti aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi.
mn99:18.1: ye te māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya. kamettha brāhmaṇā dhammaṃ mahapphalataraṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāyāti?
mn99:18.2: yeme bho gotama, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya, cāgamettha brāhmaṇā dhammaṃ mahapphalataraṃ paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāyāti.
mn99:19.6: ‘aho vata ahameva labheyyaṃ bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ, nāñño brāhmaṇo labheyya bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.
mn99:19.7: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ māṇava, vijjati: ‘yaṃ añño brāhmaṇo labheyya bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ, na so brāhmaṇo labheyya bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ.
mn99:19.8: añño brāhmaṇo labhati bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ, nāhaṃ labhāmi bhattagge aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍa’nti,
mn99:19.10: imassa pana māṇava, brāhmaṇā kiṃ vipākaṃ paññāpentī’ti?
mn99:19.11: na khottha bho gotama, brāhmaṇā evaṃ dānaṃ denti:
mn99:19.13: atha khvettha brāhmaṇā anukampājātikaṃyeva dānaṃ dentī’ti.
mn99:19.14: evaṃ sante kho māṇava, brāhmaṇānaṃ idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ puññakiriyāvatthu hoti
mn99:19.16: evaṃ sante bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ puññakiriyāvatthu hoti
mn99:20.1: ye te māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya. ime tvaṃ pañca dhamme kattha bahulaṃ samanupassasi
mn99:20.3: yeme bho gotama, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya, imāhaṃ pañca dhamme pabbajitesu bahulaṃ samanupassāmi appaṃ gahaṭṭhesu.
mn99:20.4: gahaṭṭho hi bho gotama, mahaṭṭho mahākicco mahādhikaraṇo mahāsamārambho, na satataṃ samitaṃ saccavādī hoti.
mn99:20.5: pabbajito kho pana bho gotama, appaṭṭho appakicco appādhikaraṇo appasamārambho, satataṃ samitaṃ saccavādī hoti.
mn99:20.6: gahaṭṭho hi bho gotama, mahaṭṭho mahākicco mahādhikaraṇo mahāsamārambho, na satataṃ samitaṃ tapassī hoti.
mn99:20.10: pabbajito kho pana bho gotama, appaṭṭho appakicco appādhikaraṇo appasamārambho, satataṃ samitaṃ tapassī hoti …pe…
mn99:20.14: yeme bho gotama, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti. puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya. imāhaṃ pañca dhamme pabbajitesu bahulaṃ samanupassāmi, appaṃ gahaṭṭhesūti.
mn99:21.1: ye te māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya. cittassāhaṃ eteparikkhāre vadāmi.
mn99:21.2: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.4: so saccavādīmhīti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
mn99:21.5: yantaṃ kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ, cittassāhaṃ etaṃ parikkhāraṃ vadāmi.
mn99:21.6: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.11: so cāgabahulomhīti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
mn99:21.12: yantaṃ kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ, cittassāhaṃ etaṃ parikkhāraṃ vadāmi
mn99:21.13: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.14: ye te māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya. cittassā’haṃ ete parikkhāre vadāmi
mn99:21.15: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāyāti.
mn99:22.1: evaṃ vutte subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn99:22.3: samaṇo gotamo brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggaṃ jānātīti.
mn99:22.5: āsanne ito naḷakāragāmo, nayito dūre naḷakāragāmoti?
mn99:22.6: evaṃ bho, āsanne ito naḷakāragāmo, nayito dūre naḷakāragāmoti.
mn99:22.7: taṃ kiṃ maññasi māṇava, idhassa puriso naḷakāragāme jātavaddho
mn99:22.8: tamenaṃ naḷakāragāmato tāvadeva avasaṭaṃ naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puccheyyuṃ.
mn99:22.9: siyā nu kho māṇava, tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jātavaddhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vāti?
mn99:22.12: asu hi bho gotama, puriso naḷakāragāme jātavaddho tassa sabbāneva naḷakāragāmassa maggāni suviditānīti.
mn99:22.13: siyā nu kho māṇava, tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jātavaddhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā, na tveva tathāgatassa brahmalokaṃ vā brahmalokagāminiṃ vā paṭipadaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā.
mn99:22.14: brahmānaṃ cāhaṃ māṇava, pajānāmi, brahmalokañca brahmalokagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ. yathā paṭipanno ca brahmalokaṃ upapanno, tañca pajānāmī’ti .
mn99:23.2: samaṇo gotamo brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggaṃ desetī’ti.
mn99:23.3: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggaṃ desetū’ti.
mn99:23.4: tena hi māṇava, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn99:23.5: evaṃ bhoti kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn99:24.1: katamo ca māṇava, brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggo:
mn99:24.2: idha māṇava, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
mn99:24.3: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho māṇava, mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
mn99:24.4: seyyathāpi māṇava, balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya.
mn99:24.5: evameva kho māṇava, evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā, yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati. na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
mn99:24.6: ayampi kho māṇava, brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggo.
mn99:25-27.1: puna caparaṃ māṇava, bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
mn99:25-27.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
mn99:25-27.4: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho māṇava, upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃpamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
mn99:25-27.5: seyyathāpi māṇava, balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva cātuddisā viññāpeyya.
mn99:25-27.6: evameva kho māṇava evaṃ bhāvitāya upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
mn99:25-27.7: ayampi kho māṇava, brahmānaṃ sahavyatāya maggoti.
mn99:28.1: evaṃ vutte subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn99:28.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama,
mn99:28.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn99:28.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn99:28.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
mn99:28.6: handa cadāni mayaṃ bho gotama, gacchāma,
mn99:29.2: atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn99:30.1: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetena valabhīrathena sāvatthiyā niyyāti divādivassa.
mn99:30.2: addasā kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo subhaṃ māṇavaṃ todeyyaputtaṃ
mn99:30.4: ‘handa kuto nu bhavaṃ bhāradvājo āgacchati divādivassāti?
mn99:30.5: ito hi kho bho, ahaṃ āgacchāmi samaṇassa gotamassa santikāti.
mn99:30.6: taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhavaṃ bhāradvājo, samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ paṇḍito maññeti?
mn99:30.7: ko cāhaṃ bho, ko ca samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jānissāmi.
mn99:30.8: sopi nūnassa tādisova, yo samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jāneyyāti.
mn99:30.9: uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ bhāradvājo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatīti.
mn99:30.10: ko cāhaṃ bho, ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi.
mn99:30.11: pasatthapasattho va so bhavaṃ gotamo, seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ,
mn99:30.12: ye cime bho brāhmaṇa, pañca dhamme paññāpenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya.
mn99:30.13: cittassa te samaṇo gotamo parikkhāre vadeti,
mn99:30.14: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāyāti.
mn99:31.1: evaṃ vutte jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetā vaḷabhīrathā orohitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā udānaṃ udānesi.
mn99:31.2: lābhā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, suladdhalābhā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa,
mn99:31.3: yassa vijite tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti.
